edges.reason: setOwners requires msg.sender == manager before replacing owners.
destroy requires ownerByAddress[msg.sender] or msg.sender == _from.
refundCrowdsaleContributor reads contributions[msg.sender] and refunds to msg.sender.
autoRefundCrowdsaleContributor requires owner or refundManager.
vote reads token.balanceOf(msg.sender) and records votesByAddress[msg.sender].
revokeVote reads and clears votesByAddress[msg.sender].
refundTokenHolder reads token.balanceOf(msg.sender) and transfers to msg.sender.
createTapPoll is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
createRefundPoll is gated by onlyTokenHolder checking msg.sender balance.
forceRefund requires msg.sender == refundManager.
BasePoll.onTokenTransfer requires msg.sender == fundAddress.
onTapPollFinish requires msg.sender == address(tapPoll).
onRefundPollFinish requires msg.sender == address(refundPoll).
withdraw is protected by onlyOwner.
firstWithdraw is protected by onlyOwner.
transfer moves balances[msg.sender].
transferFrom spends allowed[_from][msg.sender].
decTap is protected by onlyOwner.
finishIssuance is protected by onlyOwner.
processContribution onlyCrowdsale checks msg.sender == crowdsaleAddress.
setTokenAddress is protected by onlyOwner.
setCrowdsaleAddress is protected by onlyOwner.
PollManagedFund.onTokenTransfer requires msg.sender == address(token).
enableRefund emits RefundEnabled with msg.sender.
onCrowdsaleEnd writes lastWithdrawTime and crowdsaleEndDate from now.
withdraw sets lastWithdrawTime = now, making payouts timestamp dependent.
calcTapAmount multiplies (now - lastWithdrawTime) by tap.
vote checkTime modifier compares now with startTime and endTime.
revokeVote checkTime modifier compares now with poll window.
tryToFinalize compares now with endTime to finalize the poll.
createRefundPoll relies on checkRefundPollDate which compares now to fixed dates.
createTapPoll requires getDay(now) == 10, a timestamp dependency.
canWithdraw compares now with refundPoll.holdEndTime().
refundTokenHolder refunds at the live contract balance and logs now.
setOwners delegates the owner update to _setOwners.
createTapPoll deploys a new TapPoll contract.
createRefundPoll deploys a new RefundPoll contract.
tryToFinalize triggers onPollFinish which calls fund.onTapPollFinish.
Poll finalization calls back into the fund through onRefundPollFinish.
onRefundPollFinish invokes enableRefund when the second poll agrees.
forceRefund invokes enableRefund.
enableRefund burns tokens of reserved wallets via token.destroy.
refundCrowdsaleContributor calls token.destroy before transferring ether.
refundTokenHolder burns holder tokens via token.destroy.
autoRefundCrowdsaleContributor calls token.destroy on the contributor.
withdraw obtains the payout through calcTapAmount.
getCurrentTapAmount returns calcTapAmount().
ManagedToken.transfer calls the external eventListener.onTokenTransfer after balances move.
ManagedToken.transferFrom calls the external eventListener.onTokenTransfer after balances move.
eventListener.onTokenTransfer enters PollManagedFund.onTokenTransfer.
PollManagedFund.onTokenTransfer forwards the notification to active polls.
The active poll executes BasePoll.onTokenTransfer to adjust voter weight.
Ether is sent to msg.sender after the external token.destroy call.
msg.sender.transfer is executed after token.destroy and before event emission.
contributorAddress.transfer is an external send to an arbitrary address.
withdraw sends the computed amount to teamWallet.
firstWithdraw sends firstWithdrawAmount to teamWallet.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed mapping.
issue increases totalSupply with safeAdd.
refundCrowdsaleContributor requires state == CrowdsaleRefund.
withdraw requires state == TeamWithdraw.
decTap requires _tap < tap and updates tap.
calcTapAmount multiplies elapsed time by tap.
calcTapAmount subtracts lastWithdrawTime from now.
onTapPollFinish reads finalized state and voted percentage from tapPoll.
onRefundPollFinish reads startTime and finalized state from refundPoll.
createRefundPoll branches on secondRefundPollDate.
canWithdraw returns isWithdrawEnabled when no blocking poll exists.
destroy checks ownerByAddress[msg.sender].
The onlyOwner modifier used by setOwners checks ownerByAddress.
Fund calls token.destroy through the token state variable.
transfer consults eventListener before invoking the callback.
forceRefund authorizes the caller against refundManager.

normalization_plan.reason: The _owners parameter only flows into the setOwners owner-update routine.
The contributor parameter is only used to index contributions in processContribution.
The contributorAddress parameter is consumed only inside autoRefundCrowdsaleContributor.
The _tap parameter is validated and assigned to the tap state variable inside decTap.
The tapIncPerc parameter is only used to compute the new tap in createTapPoll.
The agree parameter only selects the yes/no counter branch inside vote.
refundAmount is a transient local computed and transferred within refundCrowdsaleContributor.
tokenBalance is a transient local read from token.balanceOf in refundTokenHolder.
voiceWeight is a transient clamped local used only in vote.
The tap amount local returned by calcTapAmount is consumed by withdraw.
